svg.title: AI Receptionist — Voice AI · SaaS
svg.desc: A real-time voice agent that books appointments, runs waitlists and hands off to humans via LLM tool-calling. A SaaS for 12 business verticals, with PII encryption and row-level security. Built with Next.js, Supabase, Retell AI, GPT-4o-mini.
